meta.title: Refactor harness for improved concurrency
meta.body_summary: Convert harness and Docker management to async using asyncio/anyio/aiodocker for reliable Ctrl+C cleanup and improved concurrency via task groups and semaphores.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor delivered large async refactor; maintainer approved but questioned design and artifact file; author closed without merge.

As a concurrency refactor without performance benchmarks, it was closed without merge despite an APPROVED review, likely due to the author's decision after maintainer feedback on design and file artifacts.

core_change_summary.description: Convert terminal_bench core from synchronous Docker and subprocess operations to async using asyncio, anyio, and aiodocker. Harness.py replaces ThreadPoolExecutor with anyio task groups and semaphores for concurrent trials. Explicit signal handling removed in favor of asyncio CancelledError propagation for cleanup. CLI entry points wrapped with asyncio.run().
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Merge commit f939518 brought in unrelated main changes including new cache module, agent tweaks, and task docker-compose edits.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: extensive async conversion across harness, Docker manager, tmux, terminal, CLI, and added ASYNC_REFACTORING.md.
Second commit: simplified async task handling, removed manual signal management, updated ASYNC_REFACTORING.md.
Merge main brought in many unrelated files (cache, agent, task fixes).
Human author fix commit: adjusted pyproject.toml, tmux_session, docker_compose_manager, and uv.lock.
